headword: {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}

definitions.explanation: A device or service that automatically answers phone calls and records messages when the recipient is unavailable. In modern usage, often refers to the voicemail function on mobile phones.

examples.japanese: {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}にメッセージを{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: I left a message on the answering machine.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}に{出|で}られないときは{留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}に{切|き}り{替|か}わります。
examples.english: When I can't answer the phone, it switches to voicemail.

examples.japanese: {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}を{確認|かくにん}したら、{病院|びょういん}からのメッセージが{入|はい}っていた。
examples.english: When I checked my voicemail, there was a message from the hospital.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{留守番|るすばん} (house-sitting, looking after the house while someone is out) + {電話|でんわ} (telephone). Literally "house-watching telephone" — a phone that answers on your behalf while you are away.

FORMS:
Often shortened to {留守電|るすでん} in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}にメッセージを{残|のこ}す (to leave a voicemail)
- {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}を{確認|かくにん}する (to check voicemail)
- {留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}に{切|き}り{替|か}わる (to switch to voicemail)
